sequenceReference.note: V12B2A-ii closed the JS-oracle drift and explicitly declared this follow-up: the adapter still deferred the customer intent because no customer-owning table existed in the JS oracle's world. This package (V12B2B) closes that follow-up now that db/metaframer_kernel_db/alembic/versions/0002_customer_records.py and the JS oracle both agree customer_records exists.

goal: src/adapters/postgres-commit-adapter.mjs commits the customer write intent into customer_records and mints a full CommitReceipt covering all four intents (customer, audit, transactionalOutbox, idempotency), atomically, in the same attested tenant transaction as the existing three.
nonGoals: no schema/Alembic/Python DB change; customer_records already exists from 0002_customer_records
no application pipeline change; ALLOW_COMMIT still starts as pending
no broad full-suite test run beyond the targeted adapter test and the repo check gate

scopeResolution.note: The adapter validates intents.customer as an ordinary object with a non-empty payload.name, and requires intents.customer.tenantId to be a non-empty string that exactly matches options.tenantId; a missing or mismatched tenantId is rejected before any DB work. It inserts into customer_records (tenant_id, name, payload) inside the same BEGIN/mfk_begin_tenant_context transaction as the audit and outbox inserts, and returns customerRecordId from RETURNING id. A duplicate idempotency fingerprint still fails the outbox insert's unique index, which rolls back the whole transaction including the customer row — no partial commit is possible.

red.note: Before this package: 2 of 4 tests failed. The module-export test expected COMMITTED_INTENTS to include "customer" and DEFERRED_INTENTS to be empty, but the adapter still reported customer as deferred. The real-PostgreSQL test expected receipt.deferredReason to be undefined and a customer row in customer_records, but the adapter returned deferredReason set and inserted no customer row.

green.results: postgres-commit-adapter.test.mjs: 6/6 pass, including two connectionless unit tests proving a missing or mismatched intents.customer.tenantId is rejected before any DB work, and the real Docker-backed PostgreSQL 16 test proving a customer_records row is inserted, a full CommitReceipt with customerRecordId/auditLogId/outboxId is returned frozen, and a duplicate idempotency fingerprint rolls back and leaves exactly one customer row and one outbox row. npm run check: exits zero.

acceptance.allFourIntentsCommitted: COMMITTED_INTENTS = [customer, audit, transactionalOutbox, idempotency]; DEFERRED_INTENTS = []; no deferredReason on the receipt
acceptance.customerValidated: intents.customer must be an ordinary object with a non-empty payload.name string; intents.customer.tenantId is mandatory, must be a non-empty string, and must exactly match options.tenantId — a missing or mismatched tenantId is rejected before any DB work
acceptance.sameTransaction: the customer_records insert happens after mfk_begin_tenant_context inside the same BEGIN/COMMIT as the audit and outbox inserts, using the runtime role's existing grants
acceptance.atomicRollback: a duplicate idempotency fingerprint rolls back the whole transaction, including the customer insert; no second customer_records row and no second transactional_outbox row are created
acceptance.receiptShape: commit() returns Object.freeze()'d receipt with receiptType: "CommitReceipt", committedIntents, deferredIntents, customerRecordId, auditLogId, outboxId
acceptance.docsUpdated: adapter file header no longer claims the S1 substrate has no customer-owning table

rollback.trigger: the adapter is found to commit the customer row outside the atomic transaction, to leak a partial commit on duplicate idempotency, or to mint a CommitReceipt that does not match the four declared intents
rollback.action: revert src/adapters/postgres-commit-adapter.mjs, tests/postgres-commit-adapter.test.mjs, this planning file and the CHANGELOG.md entry as one shard
rollback.blastRadius: adapter and its test only; no schema, migration or delivery code is touched
rollback.runtimeDataImpact: none beyond what the adapter itself writes at commit time; no migration runs

capabilityDelta: the adapter now actually persists a customer.create write intent into customer_records and returns a full CommitReceipt covering all four ALLOW_COMMIT intents; previously the customer intent was silently dropped at the adapter layer

userJourney.before: customer.create isteği ALLOW_COMMIT durumuna geliyordu ama PostgreSQL adaptörü sadece audit ve outbox kayıtlarını yazıyor, müşteri kaydını hiç veritabanına yazmıyordu. CommitReceipt eksik bir kanıttı: dört niyetten sadece üçü gerçekten commit edilmişti.
userJourney.after: Adaptör artık müşteri kaydını customer_records tablosuna, audit ve outbox kayıtlarıyla aynı atomik işlemde yazıyor. Dönen CommitReceipt dört niyetin de (customer, audit, transactionalOutbox, idempotency) gerçekten commit edildiğini gösteriyor; hiçbir niyet ertelenmiyor.
userJourney.kullaniciYolculugu: Bir tenant customer.create isteği gönderip ALLOW_COMMIT aldığında, adaptör katmanı artık müşteriyi gerçekten kaydediyor ve tam kanıt döndürüyor. Bu paket sadece adaptör katmanını kapatıyor; uçtan uca HTTP/delivery katmanı ve uygulama borusu hâlâ ayrı, planlanmamış işler.
userJourney.kalanEngel: Bu adaptörü çağıran bir delivery/HTTP katmanı henüz yok; bu yüzden runnableProduct hâlâ false.

nextPackage.note: No further follow-up declared by this package.
